decisions.reason: As a newly launched and publicly presented bread product close to the core food business, management would be inclined to continue it and interpret any early weakness as temporary.

Although the guided historic mill tour is less central than food products, its recent launch and visible website commitment still make management somewhat likely to persist rather than withdraw it immediately.
A sweet pastry fits the firm's core category and, given the fresh investment and public introduction, management would usually keep it on the market for longer before admitting failure.
